counterfactual_interventions.replacement: feature row becomes the profile mean silence vector; aligned prediction row becomes all zeros
counterfactual_interventions.target_row_selection: target channel prediction > 0.5; overlapping rows are not collapsed to argmax
counterfactual_interventions.position_control: reverse cache row order while preserving aligned feature/prediction pairs
counterfactual_interventions.matched_neutral_control: same number of channel-positive rows replaced from the other enrolled channel, restricted to rows where the target channel prediction is <= 0.5

pairwise_context_matching.reason: single AMI enrollment clips are shorter than first AOSC compression; no duplicate embeddings were generated

unknown_rejection.interpretation: forced channel assignment is not calibrated identity acceptance

performance.pairwise_timing_status: linear estimate from measured single-context inference; independent profiles unavailable

baselines.aosc_only_warm_start: immutable profile import into a newly created stream

research_limitations: one AMI meeting recording and one Mix-Headset microphone
development, calibration, and final holdout partitions are empty
single-speaker excerpts do not form ready AOSC profiles
silence replacement preserves shape but changes global cache context
no explicit speaker-verification score is exposed by native inference
fused attention does not expose weights without a risky kernel change
